verdict: 127 leads at $6.19 each this period; cost per lead rising fast.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 127 leads entirely through Meta at an average cost of $6.19 per lead — a solid baseline result. In the most recent 7 days, however, ad spend rose +140% while leads grew only +16%, pushing cost per lead up +107%; the primary campaign is scaling faster than its conversion efficiency can keep pace with. We are pulling back that campaign's budget this week to stabilise cost per lead before continuing any scale. Several planned channels — search campaigns, landing pages, and lead nurture sequences — are still being stood up, and bringing those live will reduce reliance on a single campaign and give cost per lead more room to come down.
